correctness.rationale: Sign-vector multiplication gives exact compatibility and unique joins. Every type-B face with r signed nonzero blocks has exactly r independent coarsening boundaries, giving the all-arity Stirling sum and exponential generating function. A separate restriction/merge bijection establishes each centralizer, and signed suffix cuts classify clique intersections. The supplied checker verified every face through rank 4 and lower-rank high-arity tuples and all chamber overlaps. Asymptotic by unique dominant simple pole; finite tests are not substituted for general proof.
